content.content:
1. Necessity: the prerequisites fix the removal's refusal as a precondition — removal refuses while any record naming the node is open, the refusal names each such draft by its handle, and a landed record does not block — and fix the registry those records live in: records keyed by the handle they are filed under, one target node per record, a state that begins open, moves only to landed and stays there with the record retained. Neither prerequisite is a model, so it is unsettled whether a machine holds the guard at once: which records the guard asks of, what the record's state determines, and what the guard may not add. Fail if the model artifact could be dropped without loss.

2. Conformance, applied clause by clause to the requirement sentence as recorded at check time: every clause the sentence states is settled by the artifact, and the artifact settles no clause the sentence does not state.

a. Each clause the sentence states is answered by the artifact in the same terms — which records the guard asks of, which state decides the answer, and what the refusal names — and nothing the artifact carries is left answering a clause the sentence does not state.

b. No clause added, none dropped: any condition, flag, alias, second verb, ordering or further element the artifact enforces beyond the sentence is a conformance divergence, and any clause of the sentence the artifact does not settle is one too — each named in the direction it falls.

3. Fidelity, both directions, applied to the artifact the dependent's content refs, read against the state module as recorded at check time.

a. No looser — the record form and lifecycle the artifact uses are the state module's: the registry keyed by the handle, one record per handle, the same target node and state fields the state module's record carries, the same two named state values, and the same one-way move between them with the record retained. A fact the state module fixes that the artifact omits, weakens, restates differently or leaves unconstrained is a loose divergence: name the fact and the definition it departs from.

b. No stricter — the artifact adds nothing the state module does not state: no second registry, no second or third state value, no second record shape, no transition or invariant stronger than the move the state module fixes, and no storage or serialization fact (a path, a filename, a JSON encoding, a tracking flag) modelled as part of the record. Any such element is a strict divergence: name it and the rule it adds.

The criterion names no element of the artifact in advance: which clause, field or extra rule is at issue is found while reading the artifact against the recorded prerequisites, and appears only in the finding. It tracks no wording of the dependent and survives a rewording of the dependent that leaves what it decides unchanged.
content.rationale: One model carries the removal's draft guard, and this unit's two edges both claim it. The dependent is a Quint module — a tool-checkable artifact — so both edges end on a code child: the requirement sentence that states the guard is a constrained notation, the structured-to-code cell and its conformance check, and the state module the guard's records and states come from is an artifact, the code-to-code cell whose form is a test. The check is therefore necessity plus conformance to the sentence and fidelity, in both directions, to the state module: the guard's artifact must settle exactly the refusal the sentence states — neither looser nor stricter — and take the record's form and lifecycle from the state module without restating a weaker one or smuggling in a second registry, a third state or a storage fact. That is the right gate because the artifact's shape is in question, not its running, and each of those divergences falls in one direction that a one-directional check would miss: a guard that blocked on any record would satisfy 'an open record blocks' while contradicting the sentence's exclusion, and a guard that quietly added a `--force` flag would answer nothing the sentence asks. It is applied by reading the artifact against each prerequisite as recorded at check time, so it reads whatever the prerequisites land and pins none of their wording, and it presupposes nothing their recorded text does not fix. One evaluation covers both edges because they claim one artifact from two sides and a single pass over the guard's shape answers both; splitting would read the same module twice. Nothing is run for the criterion: this unit licenses no check path, so the code-to-code edge — whose cell asks for a runnable check — is read as a static comparison of the artifact's record form against the state module, and that mixed cell is flagged for a matrix entry. In this review form red is the artifact's absence: the guard is unenforced until the module exists.
